description: Generic FoodData Central records for the US pilot: all Foundation Foods and SR Legacy foods from the official JSON downloads, plus a small explicit list of Branded records fetched by FDC ID through the API (the Branded download is 195 MB zipped / 3.1 GB). Only the four core nutrients are imported.
license: FoodData Central data are public domain / CC0 1.0. Cite: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central. fdc.nal.usda.gov.

branded_api_fdc_ids.label: MINUTE white rice (dry), 46 g serving
branded_api_fdc_ids.why: branded dry rice vs generic cooked/raw rice

branded_api_fdc_ids.label: FOOD LION white rice (dry), 45 g serving
TYSON chicken breast slice, 28 g serving
LAND O LAKES whole milk, 240 ml serving
branded_api_fdc_ids.why: ml serving: no gram portion without a density

energy_kcal.note: Foundation reports Atwater specific (2048) or general (2047) energy; ID 1008 is no longer shown for Foundation since Oct 2020 but remains for SR Legacy and Branded. kcal only; kJ (1062) is not used.

fat_g.note: 1004 Total lipid (fat); 1085 Total fat (NLEA) only if 1004 is absent.

carbohydrate_g.note: 1005 Carbohydrate, by difference; 1050 by summation only if 1005 is absent or negative.

negative_values: A negative source amount (seen for carbohydrate by difference) is rejected, never clamped to 0: the next documented nutrient ID is used, else the value is stored as unknown (NULL). Counts appear in each import report.
basis: Foundation and SR Legacy amounts are per 100 g edible portion. Branded amounts are per 100 g or per 100 ml as received from the data provider.
branded_policy: Branded records are a separate pool: returned only when a visible brand is requested, never ranked against generic records.
branded_selection_note: IDs chosen on 2026-10-02 from FDC search results (dataType=Branded, queries 'white rice', 'chicken breast', 'whole milk') to exercise branded handling; they are not a coverage claim.
